bio.text: David Jolly is the Democratic nominee for governor of Florida in the November 3, 2026 general election, running on a joint ticket with Gwen Graham.
As a Republican, he represented Florida's 13th Congressional District in the U.S. House from March 14, 2014 to January 3, 2017.
He earned a B.A. from Emory University in 1994 and a J.D. from George Mason University School of Law in 2001, and was a staff member for Rep. Bill Young from 1994 to 2006.
In 2022 he announced the formation of the Forward Party with Andrew Yang and Christine Todd Whitman.
According to his campaign website, he is an attorney who served for nearly a decade as a political analyst on NBC and MSNBC, and he and his wife are raising their family in Pinellas County.
